description: Catalog of agent harnesses — coding-agent runtimes, harness toolkits, and orchestration frameworks used across the FlexNetOS meta workspace.

harnesses.summary: A standalone coding agent with the IDE wired in — a TypeScript/Rust/Bun monorepo (omp) with its own TUI, swarm-extension, and agent/ai packages. Not a Claude Code plugin; a coding-agent harness of its own.
The harness toolkit/landing vendored in this repo at harness/ (skills, docs, site). Source of the `harness` meta-skill that defines specialized agents and the skills they use.
harnesses.notes: Vendored in-repo at harness/ (nested .git stripped). Not a nested-meta child; lives directly in harness_hub's tree.

harnesses.summary: First packaged harness shipped by the harness plugin. An autonomous, resumable, self-restarting Ralph loop (/harness:meta-plugin) that organizes the FlexNetOS meta workspace via harness_hub/meta-plugins/meta_plugin_protocol/meta_plugin_api: hub/registry consistency, cross-repo build/test/lint health, protocol↔consumer drift, and catalog/inventory organization. Run in place or eject into a target repo's .claude/.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness inside the harness plugin (harness/skills/meta-plugin + shared agents in harness/agents/). Invoke /harness:meta-plugin; ejectable via skills/meta-plugin/scripts/eject.sh. Pilot for the packaged-harness convention (docs/packaged-harness-standard.md).

harnesses.summary: FlexNetOS handoff/continuity kernel — the hf binary + .handoff/ witnessed ledger. The only sanctioned cross-session continuity path: checkpoint/handoff packets are rendered from the ledger, never hand-written. Ships the handoff-discipline harness (skills + agents) and fleet coordination.

Rust-native agent-to-agent session mesh with a native tmux/zellij injector — concurrent coding-agent sessions message each other and push into a running terminal pane (degrades to hook-delivery-on-next-turn with no multiplexer). One static binary; ships an MCP server (weave_send/ask/inbox/…). The workspace's real-time messaging substrate; complements the handoff continuity kernel.

Packaged harness (/harness:rust-port): an autonomous, resumable Ralph loop that performs a full-feature, NO-DOWNGRADE port of a source project (TypeScript/Python/...) to idiomatic Rust. A parity ledger inventories every source unit; each is ported fully (no stubs), then differentially parity-verified (source vs Rust) before it counts as done. DONE only at 100% with a left-behind sweep — no feature logic left behind.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness in the harness plugin (harness/skills/rust-port + rust-port-* sub-skills + shared session-relay-*/cross-repo-health/harness-loop-init/harness-evolution; 7 shared agents incl. evolution-steward). Invoke /harness:rust-port; ejectable via skills/rust-port/scripts/eject.sh. DONE gate covers per-symbol parity (symbol-map.md) + runtime-construct differential coverage. Flagship use case: full-feature TS->Rust port of meta/Archon.

harnesses.summary: Packaged harness (/harness:code-research): an autonomous, resumable, READ-ONLY loop that deeply researches and analyzes a codebase to answer a question with cited, adversarially-verified evidence. Maps the code + decomposes the question into dimensions; fan-out analysts produce file:line-cited claims; an adversarial verifier tries to REFUTE each claim against the source (running it where ambiguous); a synthesizer writes a decision-grade report (verdict-first, confidence-rated, gaps named). Conclusions are earned by evidence that survived refutation — not plausible guesses.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness in the harness plugin (harness/skills/code-research + code-research-* sub-skills + shared agents). Invoke /harness:code-research; ejectable. Read-only: maps a codebase, fan-out analysts produce cited claims, adversarial verifier refutes claims vs code, synthesizer writes a decision-grade report.
